config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-www.example.org"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "www.example.org"
next

edit "Prefix-*.cdn.example.net"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "*.cdn.example.net"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.5"
set subnet 10.0.0.5 255.255.255.255
next

edit "Prefix-192.168.1.0/24"
set subnet 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
next

edit "Prefix-10.20.0.0/16"
set subnet 10.20.0.0 255.255.0.0
next

edit "Prefix-10.9.8.7"
set subnet 10.9.8.7 255.255.255.255
next

edit "Prefix-10.30.0.0/24"
set subnet 10.30.0.0 255.255.255.0
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.0.10-172.16.0.20"
set type iprange
set start-ip 172.16.0.10
set end-ip 172.16.0.20
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.0.30-172.16.0.40"
set type iprange
set start-ip 172.16.0.30
set end-ip 172.16.0.40
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.0.50-172.16.0.45"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "172.16.0.50-172.16.0.45"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.999"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "10.0.0.999"
next

edit "Prefix-a-very-long-fqdn-label-used-to-exceed-the-fortigate-name-limit.some-quite-long-subdomain.example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "a-very-long-fqdn-label-used-to-exceed-the-fortigate-name-limit.some-quite-long-subdomain.example.com"
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-www.example.org" "Prefix-*.cdn.example.net" "Prefix-10.0.0.5" "Prefix-192.168.1.0/24" "Prefix-10.20.0.0/16" "Prefix-10.9.8.7" "Prefix-10.30.0.0/24" "Prefix-172.16.0.10-172.16.0.20" "Prefix-172.16.0.30-172.16.0.40" "Prefix-172.16.0.50-172.16.0.45" "Prefix-10.0.0.999" "Prefix-a-very-long-fqdn-label-used-to-exceed-the-fortigate-name-limit.some-quite-long-subdomain.example.com"
next

end
